subject.title: feat(discord): opt-in Discord Activities widget support

question: After the authorization path is unified and real Discord proof is supplied, should the bundled Discord plugin permanently expose this opt-in public OAuth and agent-authored HTML Activity surface?
rationale: Tests cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own this new public route, credential, browser dependency, and arbitrary-widget trust boundary; Discord and security-owner intent is required.

options.title: Approve after repair and proof
options.body: Accept the bundled feature only after canonical guild/channel authorization, focused regression coverage, and successful redacted real-client evidence are present.

options.title: Decline the bundled surface
options.body: Keep Discord limited to existing portable presentation primitives and move Activity widgets to an external plugin or separate product surface.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the bundled feature only after canonical guild/channel authorization, focused regression coverage, and successful redacted real-client evidence are present.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice primarily concerns Discord subsystem policy and the permanent user-facing Activity integration boundary.
